perf_recommendations: Region choice: direct them to eu-west-1 for EU users; recommend per-request region param to avoid cross-region hops.
Timeouts: suggest client timeout 30s, server hard limit 60s; set shorter socket timeouts for streaming fallbacks.
Prompt length: keep history under ~1k tokens for chat-heavy flows; truncate and store long contexts for embeddings search instead.
Streaming: enable streaming in SDK to improve perceived latency (TTFB) even if full generation continues.
Batching & rerank guidance: use smaller, frequent batches for re-ranks during peaks; consider async re-rank queue for heavy spikes.
Model variants: recommend lighter generation model for low-latency quick responses and fallback to higher-quality model for longer completions.
Caching: prefix-level caching for repeated queries (order status templates) to remove redundant token costs and speed responses.
